import pandas as pd

import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date column to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Aggregate total sales by product and size
sales_by_product_size = df.groupby(['product', 'size'])['total'].sum().unstack()

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sales_by_product_size.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, colormap='viridis', ax=plt.gca())

# Add titles and labels

plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Size', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the plot
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date column to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Aggregate total sales by product and size
sales_by_product_size = df.groupby(['product', 'size'])['total'].sum().unstack()

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sales_by_product_size.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, colormap='viridis', ax=plt.gca())

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Total Sales by Product and Size')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Size', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the plot
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
